Sam (CS): Quick check-in for AtlasCare private deploy — they hit an error when enabling CMEK for S3 audit export. Can infra confirm KMS key policy example?
Jess (Infra): Looking. do we have their KMS key ARN?
Sam (CS): Taylor sent ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/7a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789. They said they need cross-account decrypt for our logging service.
Mike (Security): KMS needs a cross-account statement. Recommend minimal policy snippet for the key (share with customer):
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodLogs",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999988887777:role/redwood-logs" },
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Priya (Solutions): Heads up — AtlasCare is currently flagged medium renewal risk if onboarding slips >2 weeks. Can Infra prioritize the KMS/CloudTrail bits this week?
Jess (Infra): We can prioritize. Need the exact role ARN from AtlasCare and confirmation of S3 bucket for audit export. I can put together a quick terraform snippet too.
Taylor (AtlasCare): Confirm role ARN: arn:aws:iam::999988887777:role/atlas-logs-role. Audit bucket is s3://atlascare-redwood-audit. We also need the export to be encrypted with our CMEK.
Sam (CS): @deploy-bot run quick KMS policy check against that ARN?
deploy-bot: CI check 'kms-cross-account' started for atlascare  (job 4821)
deploy-bot: CI check 'kms-cross-account' passed in 3m 12s — artifact: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4821/logs
Mike (Security): One more recommendation: enable CloudTrail log file validation + S3 object lock lifecycle for the audit bucket (compliance). Share exact commands if you want.
Jess (Infra): I'll draft the Terraform snippet and paste here before EOD. Estimated ~45m work to update and test in staging.
Priya (Solutions): I'll schedule a 30m enablement call to walk AtlasCare through IAM/KMS steps. Proposed: Tue 10am PT or Wed 9am PT.
Taylor (AtlasCare): Tue 10am PT works for us. We have our infra lead on the call.
Sam (CS): Great — marking onboarding status: 'in-progress -> at-risk (KMS block)'. Once we run the terraform patch and do the call we should move to 'on track'. I'll update the renewal tracker and loop in Finance. :white_check_mark: 
Jess (Infra): tagging follow-ups: @Mike (Security) to review key policy, @Priya (Solutions) to send calendar invite, @Sam (CS) to update renewal sheet.
Mike (Security): will review the tf snippet once posted. Also request: customer to enable CloudTrail validation and provide the trail ARN so we can confirm deliveries.
Taylor (AtlasCare): Will provide trail ARN ahead of the call. Thanks everyone!
